mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 2% MoM does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight labor market and high interest rates create a stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) remains below 4%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 300,000 and UNRATE < 4% does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If a sustained decrease in FEDFUNDS over 3 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
